Class SSEEventListener

java.lang.Object
org.a2aproject.sdk.client.transport.spi.sse.AbstractSSEEventListener
org.a2aproject.sdk.client.transport.jsonrpc.sse.SSEEventListener
public class SSEEventListener extends AbstractSSEEventListener
JSON-RPC transport implementation of SSE event listener. Handles parsing of JSON-RPC formatted messages from SSE streams.
